01 — About

Who is YCZ?

I'm YCZ — a crypto-native builder and community leader from Indonesia. As the founder of Airdrop Empire, a Telegram community dedicated to Web3 alpha and airdrop hunting, I've been growing alongside the crypto ecosystem for years.

My passion lies in connecting projects with real communities — whether that's hosting an AMA on X, moderating a Telegram group, speaking at a university, or pitching product knowledge to new adopters.

Fluent in both English and Bahasa Indonesia, I bridge global crypto projects with Southeast Asian communities — one of the world's fastest-growing Web3 markets.
